analysis:
The supplied units are head-side excerpts of CHANGELOG.md (lines 3063-3453), which is historical release-note text for v0.9.7 through v0.9.15. The file_changes patch shows the real PR change is a documentation addition at the top of the file (new v0.10.7 candidate section, head lines 11-413). That section is outside the supplied units except for an orientation excerpt. No executable code, configuration, workflow or security control is changed in what I could see.

The excerpted historical entries describe prior security-relevant behavior, including SSD prefix-cache TTL and write budget, App Attest protocol 3 only, removal of the unauthenticated earnings endpoint (T-031), and fail-closed attestation challenges. They are narrative of earlier releases. I found no sign that they were altered by this PR, and a changelog edit cannot weaken a control. I did not re-verify any of those claims against source.

Remaining uncertainty: the v0.10.7 text at head lines 11-413 was not supplied in full. Its claims about cluster pairing, tensor-parallel public models, update behavior and fail-closed pairing are not covered here. If the corresponding code is in the PR, it needs review in other units. The new cluster or pair feature may add a provider-to-provider trust boundary that the threat model does not yet cover. Specifically, the same-build pairing requirement and the coordinated update of the two Macs are unverified. I treat this as a question for integration, not a finding. The T-041 prefix-cache TTL of 30 minutes and the $750 GB/day budget mentioned in the excerpt match the canonical threat model's TTL statements. The write budget was not covered by the model text I saw.
